data.title: 烧盐柠檬 · 体育馆绿荫售货机前的冰汽水贴颊

data.action: pressing a chilled condensation-beaded soda can playfully toward viewer cheek, laughing with cute snaggletooth fangs and sweaty flushed cheeks

data.promptProse: Lemon playfully presses a chilled condensation-covered soda can against the viewer cheek, laughing heartily with her cute snaggletooth under the summer trees.
